description: Rank listed storage by price per terabyte (unit "tb") or memory by price per gigabyte (unit "gb"), cheapest first, using current prices. Unit prices are in pence. The unit is required, because the two scales cannot be mixed in one ranking.

category.description: Restrict to one or more categories within the chosen unit.

unit.description: "tb" for storage (hdd, ssd, nvme, external, usb), "gb" for memory (ram).

name: get_best_value
title: Best value storage and memory
